capabilities: search the vault for potential bidirectional links
convert selected plain-text occurrences to wikilinks in place
add items to an ignore list to exclude them from results
remove existing wikilinks from selected content
exclude notes under a given relative path from searching and changes
extras: Over 95% of the code was generated with codeGPT and only self-tested; the author advises backing up the vault before use and says further updates are unlikely. README also documents known performance and usability issues.
problem: Large vaults contain many occurrences of existing note titles left as plain text, and adding those bidirectional links by hand across all notes is slow.

relations.evidence: It is recommended to use this plugin together with the Various Complements

summary: Vault-wide linker that searches notes for text matching existing content and converts selected occurrences to [[wikilinks]].
